user.title: Set up lawn
user.description: Select your OpenWeatherMap weather entity. Optional valve control is disabled until configured and enabled.

data.name: Name
data.mower_location: Mower position or dock status (required with valve)
data.mower_safe_state: State confirming the mower is docked
data.allow_unmetered_manual: Allow manual timer without water meter
data.initial_gts: Current grassland temperature sum (0 for automatic start)

data_description.initial_gts: If installing during the year, enter a known starting value here. From the next January 1, the integration starts automatically at 0.
data_description.temperature_entity: This sensor has priority. If it is not selected or is unavailable, the current OpenWeatherMap temperature is used automatically.
data_description.mowed_entity: An off-to-on transition records mowing and acknowledges the mowing season. Without a selection, use the manual button.
data_description.watered_entity: An off-to-on transition records watering and updates the soil model. Without a selection, use the manual button.
data_description.irrigation_valve: Select a controllable switch. With a valve, the existing watering button starts a supervised session.
data_description.irrigation_flow: Select a sensor in L, m³, L/min, L/h, L/s or m³/h. Shared-meter usage during an active session is attributed to the lawn.
data_description.other_valve: When this competing valve opens, lawn irrigation pauses. If omitted it is assumed closed; a configured valve must report its state reliably.
data_description.mower_location: Select a lawn_mower, vacuum, binary sensor or status sensor. Valve starts only when the selected entity explicitly reports the safe state.
data_description.mower_safe_state: Use docked for lawn_mower/vacuum, on for a binary dock sensor, or the exact state of a custom sensor.
data_description.allow_unmetered_manual: Manual watering runs for the minimum time only, with no measured water added to the soil model. Automatic starts still require a sensor.
data_description.flow_start_grace_seconds: Stop if no positive, plausible flow is seen after this time. Safety always overrides the minimum watering time.
data_description.precipitation_entity: Accepts precipitation depth or precipitation intensity. Without a sensor, no rain is added to the soil model; forecasts are used only for recommendations.
data_description.precipitation_mode: Automatic uses the unit and state class. Select a fixed type if your sensor reports an ambiguous value in mm.
data_description.soil_moisture_entity: Gently calibrates the modeled soil reservoir toward the measured percentage every six hours. Without a sensor, the model continues independently.
data_description.soil_temperature_entity: When selected, soil temperature takes priority for vegetation-state decisions.
data_description.default_watering_amount: Amount added to the soil model when watering is recorded and no calculated recommendation is available.
data_description.initial_soil_moisture: Starting value of the virtual soil reservoir. For normal loamy soil, 70% is a reasonable initial estimate.
data_description.root_depth_cm: Effective depth of the active lawn root zone. Ten centimeters preserves the previous model behavior.
data_description.slope: A steeper surface reduces infiltration during intense rain.
data_description.compaction: Compacted soil accepts water more slowly and produces more runoff.
data_description.irrigation_efficiency: Fraction of applied irrigation that reaches the modeled root zone.
data_description.rain_correction: Corrects systematic over- or underestimation of the observed rain source. 1.0 leaves it unchanged.
data_description.soil_sensor_dry: Raw percentage shown by the physical sensor in dry soil.
data_description.soil_sensor_wet: Raw percentage shown by the physical sensor near field capacity. Must be greater than the dry reference.

error.not_openweathermap: The selected entity is not provided by the OpenWeatherMap integration.
error.weather_data_unavailable: The OpenWeatherMap entity does not provide a current temperature. Prefer mode v3.0 and verify that the entity is available.
error.name_already_configured: Another lawn already uses this name.
error.name_required: Enter a name for the lawn.
error.soil_sensor_range_invalid: The wet sensor reference must be greater than the dry reference.
error.mower_required: Select a reliable dock status before configuring a valve.
error.flow_required: Select a water meter or explicitly allow manual timer mode.
error.valve_already_used: Another lawn already controls this valve.
error.other_valve_same: The other valve must differ from the lawn valve.
error.maximum_below_minimum: Maximum must be greater than minimum.
error.safe_state_required: Enter a state confirming the mower is at the dock.

abort.already_configured: A lawn with this name is already configured.

irrigation.title: Irrigation hardware

data.mower_location: Mower position or dock status (required with valve)

data_description.irrigation_valve: Select a switch to enable supervised valve control. Without a switch, the watering button retains its recording behavior.
data_description.other_valve: Optional competing valve: irrigation pauses while open and closes if its configured state becomes unknown.
data_description.irrigation_flow: Select a live meter in L, m³, L/min, L/h, L/s or m³/h. A shared meter is attributed only while the lawn valve is open.
data_description.mower_location: Select a mower entity, vacuum, dock binary sensor, or custom status sensor. Valve starts only if the mower is confirmed docked.
data_description.mower_safe_state: For custom status sensors, enter the value that means safely docked. Lawn mower/vacuum use docked; binary dock sensors use on.
data_description.allow_unmetered_manual: An explicit time-only manual mode does not infer an unmeasured water volume.

safety.title: Irrigation safety
safety.description: Safety limits and manual watering duration.

data_description.min_irrigation_minutes: Applies to manual starts unless a safety condition requires earlier shutdown.
data_description.max_irrigation_minutes: Safety limit for every irrigation session.
data_description.max_irrigation_liters: Safety limit that overrides the manual minimum runtime.
data_description.flow_start_grace_seconds: Maximum time without a plausible positive water-flow reading.

data_description.default_watering_amount: Amount added to the soil model when watering is recorded and no calculated recommendation is available.
data_description.root_depth_cm: Effective depth of the active lawn root zone. Ten centimeters preserves the previous model behavior.

data_description.rain_correction: Corrects systematic over- or underestimation of the observed rain source. 1.0 leaves it unchanged.
data_description.soil_sensor_dry: Raw percentage shown by the physical sensor in dry soil.
data_description.soil_sensor_wet: Raw percentage shown by the physical sensor near field capacity. Must be greater than the dry reference.

irrigation_valve_stuck.title: Lawn irrigation valve failed to close
irrigation_valve_stuck.description: The controlled valve has not reported closed after a stop command. Check the physical valve and its connection immediately; the integration will retry closing it.

temperature_unavailable.title: Outdoor temperature unavailable
temperature_unavailable.description: Neither the selected outdoor sensor nor the OpenWeatherMap weather entity currently provides a valid temperature. Check both entities.

forecast_unavailable.title: Weather forecast unavailable
forecast_unavailable.description: No daily or hourly forecast is currently available. Check the selected OpenWeatherMap entity and its configured mode.

configured_entity_unavailable.title: Configured input entity unavailable
configured_entity_unavailable.description: The configured entity `{entity_id}` is missing, unknown, or unavailable. Correct the entity under Configure or restore it.

forecast_stale.title: Weather forecast is stale
forecast_stale.description: The last successful forecast update is more than three hours old. Check OpenWeatherMap and its API availability.

observed_precipitation_unavailable.title: Observed precipitation unavailable
observed_precipitation_unavailable.description: No usable observed precipitation sensor was found. Enable the OpenWeatherMap rain sensor or select a precipitation sensor in the integration options.

current_weather_stale.title: Current weather data is stale
current_weather_stale.description: The current OpenWeatherMap observations are more than three hours old. The water model is using a reduced fallback calculation until fresh humidity, wind, and cloud data are available.
